scope: Registered X2 hard-negative candidate-evidence ranking (docs/registered_x2_ladder_v1.md): base and A1 step-60/step-100 scored on the frozen structured negative sets for the 600 geometry-template pairs. The registered ladder metric is pair-success against the structured negative sets (both members rank their own gold above every candidate in the set); the golds-only margin statistic is candidate-set-invariant by construction and is reported alongside for continuity with the v1 number it supersedes.

scoring.primary_score: mean conditional log probability over every exact completion token
scoring.ladder_metric: candidate_pair_top1: both members rank their own gold first within the frozen structured negative set
scoring.tie_policy: ties lose for top-1 and take the conservative worst rank
scoring.mathematical_equivalence: canonical-v2 symmetric equivalence; tolerance 1e-4; unit-changing answers remain distinct

analysis.branch_reason: The interpretation ladder is pre-committed in docs/registered_x2_ladder_v1.md and is applied mechanically to the base-model ladder metric; whichever branch obtains ships without renegotiation.

required_terms: latent preference for the correct answer
interpretation.hypothesis_language_permitted: already perceived/understood (framing and discussion only; result language requires the top branch plus B1 premise-probe convergence)
